outcome: Shift of the oxyhaemoglobin dissociation curve (ODC)
cohort: The study included 21 premature ventilated infants born at less than 31 weeks of gestation who were mechanically ventilated on day three of life.
finding: Caffeine led to a transient decrease in intrapulmonary shunt, which was significantly reduced at 1h and 4h post-administration compared to baseline, but returned to baseline by 20h.
